observations: The compliant case called the real InnoAgent endpoint and drained archive and portrait outboxes.
The correction case was stopped deterministically because acceptance_notice was missing.
The uncertain case retained a limitation and was routed to exception instead of being auto-approved.
The transient timeout entered retrying; a business failure remained pending_review without blocking other outbox work.
scope: This artifact verifies routing, protocol execution, cleanup, and queue behavior. It is not a statistical accuracy or learning-outcome evaluation.
